builds.name: Reference: Long-range finish
builds.goal: Reference for Caitlyn: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged zoning marksman who turns traps and net hits into long-range Headshots while using Q to pressure lines of enemies. Keep trap/net Headshots separate from ordinary crit attacks. Compare range-safe trap setup with a physical ability/pick route and record whether Q damage survives target blocking. Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Caitlyn: Keep trap/net Headshots separate from ordinary crit attacks. Compare range-safe trap setup with a physical ability/pick route and record whether Q damage survives target blocking.

Start with the early core (Collector, then Infinity Edge) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit and a Rapid Firecannon attack window test safer pick damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.

The route fails Caitlyn's stated kit question: Keep trap/net Headshots separate from ordinary crit attacks. Compare range-safe trap setup with a physical ability/pick route and record whether Q damage survives target blocking.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: RFC does not extend every ability; its charged attack must actually be consumed.
Full cost 16,950 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Collector, then Infinity Edge. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rapid Firecannon, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Every [5] Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as [(1 + 1)] for building towards a Headshot.

Headshots deal an additional [((characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.6, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.20000000298023224, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.20000000298023224, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + ((1) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1)))) × AD] physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by {{Spell_CaitlynEntrapment_Name}} and {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}}. Headshots against enemies hit by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} deal a further @spell.CaitlynW:HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage.
Caitlyn fires a net, pushing her backwards. The net Slows the first target hit by [50]% for [1] second and deals [80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for [1.5] seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for [30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50] seconds, and [3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5] traps may be active at once. This Ability has [3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5] charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional [35 / 80 / 125 / 170 / 215 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage from Headshot.

Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing [(300 / 475 / 650 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.

Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing [50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (1.25 / 1.45 / 1.65 / 1.85 / 2.05) × AD] physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals [(50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (1.25 / 1.45 / 1.65 / 1.85 / 2.05) × AD) × (0.6)] physical damage.

Enemies revealed by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} always take full damage.
